caseName: Incorporated Village of Port Jefferson v. Board of Supervisors
caseNameFull: INCORPORATED VILLAGE OF PORT JEFFERSON v. BOARD OF SUPERVISORS OF THE COUNTY OF SUFFOLK
attorneys: William M. Johnson for appellants., Stanley S. Corwin for Board of Supervisors of Suffolk County et al., and Frederick Mars for Receiver of Taxes of the Town of Brookhaven, appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
